name: Sant Martí de Centelles (Spain)
description: Barry of blue, white, yellow and blue, the outer stripes twice the width of the central two, charged at the centre with a lozenge quartered per saltire yellow and red.
history: The flag was approved on 18 July 1991 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1475 of 2 August 1991; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, barry blue, white, yellow and blue, the upper and lower stripes twice as wide as the two central ones, with a lozenge of 4/6 of the height quartered per saltire yellow and red.

features.role: lozenge 4/6 of the height quartered per saltire yellow and red
